name: kleinos-stdlib
description: KleinBOTTLE internal capability layer. Provides analysis, introspection, and operations tools that KleinOS apps call into. Apps depend on this; the main KleinBOTTLE app does not.

tools.summary: Exact and structural (locally-renamed) duplicate detection via AST fingerprints.
Structural similarity ranking; near-duplicate detection.
Unused functions, classes, and imports via cross-file reference analysis.
Cyclomatic complexity + nesting + length composite score per function.
Full import dependency graph with circular chain detection.
Finds UI-blocking calls (subprocess, sleep, requests, socket, etc.).
Flags domain boundary violations by function/class/file.
Plans safe decomposition of large Python modules.
Maps Tkinter widget hierarchy, geometry, and bindings from source.
Navigate filesystem, Python code units, or caller-supplied hierarchies.
File tree with sizes, line counts, timestamps, optional docstrings.
Full-text search via ripgrep with Python-native fallback.
Single-document orientation: tool inventory + env + constraints.
Launch packet for agents: host + workspace + commands + deps.
Resolves project/sidecar/git roots; reports key operational surfaces.
Assembles a single-file adversarial review bundle.
Reads CONTROL.md + STATUS.md + recent journal into structured state.
Checks venv, lockfiles, requirements, tool availability. Read-only.
Reports OS, Python, shell, and dev command availability. Read-only.
Reports running processes and listening ports. Read-only.
Discovers declared setup/test/run/build/dev commands from project files.
Guarded dev-server lifecycle: start/stop/status/logs.
Dry-run-first cleanup of generated artifacts. Confirm required.
Scans for committed secrets and risky env exposure. Read-only.
Guarded Docker: build, smoke-run, logs. Push gated behind confirmation.
Guarded kubectl: dry-run/apply/status/logs. Mutation gated.
Schema introspection: tables, columns, types, PKs, indexes, row counts.
Diffs two SQLite schemas: added/dropped tables, columns, indexes.
Generates test file skeletons from Python source (AST-extracted public API).
Meta-runner: discovers and runs all smoke_test.py files in the toolbox.
Whitespace-immune hunk patcher using tokenization.

journal.note: Journal tools require journal_init to run first. All others are standalone.

tools.summary: Bootstrap: creates SQLite DB, project folders, seeds contract.
Create/update/append journal entries with CAS body storage.
Search and filter journal entries or fetch by UID.
Export filtered entries to Markdown or JSON files.
Query the shared human/AI action ledger.
Returns package manifest, DB manifest, schema summary, migration history.
Unpacks standard project layout templates from DB to disk.
Pack/unpack tool source code into/from the DB.
Create, list, inspect, and verify merkle snapshots.
Record contract acknowledgment by agent or human.

apps.summary: Code structure audit: duplicate functions, dead code, and complexity scores.
Safety audit: blocking calls that can freeze a UI or async thread.
Donor-material finder: given a plain-language concept, ranks existing functions by relevance.
